# 知乎 (Zhihu)

> > China's largest knowledge-sharing and Q&A platform, featuring curated daily digests, expert answers, and in-depth discussions on history, science, culture, and current affairs.

Zhihu serves as China's premier question-and-answer community where users share knowledge, experiences, and insights across diverse topics. The platform includes Zhihu Daily (知乎日报), which curates high-quality content with approximately 21 minutes of reading time delivered three times daily.

## Key Topics

- 知乎日报 (Zhihu Daily)
- 知乎 (Zhihu)
- 中国 (China)
- 慈禧 (Empress Dowager Cixi)
- 青藏高原 (Qinghai-Tibet Plateau)

- 旺代叛乱 (War in the Vendée)
- 尼罗河 (Nile River)
- 黄河 (Yellow River)
- 百年孤独 (One Hundred Years of Solitude)

## Daily Digest & Curated Content

- [知乎日报 - 每天 3 次，每次 7 分钟](https://daily.zhihu.com/?k=compilation&top): Zhihu Daily: curated high-quality articles with 21-min avg reading time, delivered three times daily with carefully selected content from the Zhihu community
